description: This file defines the 'DigitalProduct' entity class for managing digital product data within the e-commerce system. It maps to the 'PRODUCT_DIGITAL' table and includes fields for product reference and file name, along with ORM annotations.

classes.name: DigitalProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a digital product, mapping to the PRODUCT_DIGITAL table, including references to the associated product and file name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the digital product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the digital product.

methods.name: getProductFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the file name associated with this digital product.

methods.name: setProductFileName
methods.description: Sets the file name for this digital product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product entity with this digital product.
